title: API base URL
desc: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. GWDG / Max Planck Chat AI: https://chat-ai.academiccloud.de/v1. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1

title: Model
desc: With the GWDG / Academic Cloud API, pick one of the recommended models from the list (or Other model... for any name). For other providers, type the model name. It must support tool calling; the Models button in the assistant window lists what your key can use.

title: API key
desc: Your personal key. Stored in your own GlowTracker settings file, not in the code. Leave empty to use the GLOWTRACKER_LLM_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

title: Memory file
desc: Where the assistant keeps lessons it learned on this microscope (you approve each one). Leave empty for the default in your user data folder; point several PCs at one shared file to share lessons.

title: Your setup (added to every new conversation)
Object of interest
desc: What the microscope tracks, e.g. the pharynx of C. elegans.

title: Animal and strain
desc: Species, strain or genotype, opsin and cofactor, e.g. C. elegans, AWA::Chrimson, grown on ATR.

title: Output DAC0
desc: What DAC0 drives and how it responds to voltage, e.g. a buzzer that sounds at 0 V and is quiet at 4.5 V.

title: Output DAC1
desc: What DAC1 drives and how it responds to voltage, e.g. a 590 nm optogenetic LED, brighter with higher voltage up to 4.95 V.

title: Other notes
desc: Anything else the assistant should know: lab rules (baseline before stimulation, maximum light dose), magnification, conventions.
